methodology: Three independent processes per version, 8 warmup and 21 measurement rounds per scenario. Summary is median of process medians. Order: optimized/original/simplified, simplified/original/optimized, original/optimized/simplified. Original is before load simplification, simplified is before Promise optimization, optimized is current. Positive deltas mean slower. In-memory stores, no network. Promise allocation probes run separately from timing. Absolute Promise counts include identical harness overhead. Small differences and inconsistent per-run signs should not be interpreted as stable regressions or improvements.

original.methodology: Both snapshots transpiled with the same TypeScript/ES2019/CommonJS settings. Identical in-memory stores and payloads; no cloning, network or I/O. Preparation excluded. Versions alternate; explicit GC between samples, GC during timing included. Refresh full-cycle includes the event-loop barrier and both store writes. Singleflight ns/op is per reader.
